verdict.rationale: Flutterwave documents creating a hosted payment page and redirecting customers to it, so developers do not need to build their own payment UI. It also offers prebuilt UIs, and its marketing describes a 'smart payment ordering system' aimed at conversion. Evidence is limited to short first-party doc and marketing snippets, missing for 10: detailed docs on the hosted-checkout flow and customization, concrete evidence of conversion optimization beyond marketing copy, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can redirect customers to a vendor-hosted, conversion-optimized checkout page without building my own payment UI

citations.quote: Create a hosted payment page and redirect your customer to it to pay.
Our online checkout features our smart payment ordering system, incredible speed, and beautiful simplicity.
You can get started quickly with our SDKs and prebuilt UIs
